segments.contextAfter: There are three modes supported for `QuantizationGranularity`: `per_tensor`, `per_channel`, `per_block`. `per_tensor` granularity computes a single float scale value (and zero point, in the case of symmetric quantization) for the whole tensor. `per_channel` granularity uses a scale factor for each outer dimension (also referred to as the `output channel`) of the weight tensor.
